name: Telemetry Relay
description: Forwards live match/player/pickup telemetry from each game instance to ql-stats-hub through a per-host relay sidecar.

host_relay.description: Relay sidecar for this host. Enable it to forward telemetry from every instance on this host to the stats-hub target below (falls back to the cluster-wide default when left blank).

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Deploys and starts the relay sidecar on this host.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

fields.label: Ingest token override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

instance_telemetry.description: Reserves this instance's cluster-wide stats-hub server ID and points its qlx_statsHub* cvars at the host relay. Requires the relay enabled on the host. Applies config and restarts the instance.

fields.label: Reserved server ID
fields.description: Read-only result of the reservation. 0 means telemetry has never been enabled for this instance. Saving reserves one and applies the config.

global_settings.description: Cluster-wide stats-hub target. Individual hosts may override both values.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Default ql-stats-hub base URL every host's relay forwards to.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. The wrong one fails silently with a 401 that trips the circuit breaker on every feed.
